title: URBEX | Abandoned Soviet Space Shuttles (Buran) in Baikonur
summary: Urban explorers break into the Baikonur cosmodrome in Kazakhstan to film the abandoned Soviet Buran space shuttles. The video shows the decaying orbiters and the dangerous trip to reach them.
why: Linked in space and Soviet-history threads as striking footage of the rotting Buran shuttles.

quote.text: There's video on youtube of people sneaking in (it's a guarded base), flying drones around them and climbing around in and out of them. It's pretty cool.
